title: Cram IB Chemistry in 1 Week (2025): Survival Guide
summary: IB Chemistry cramming in 7 days for 2025: a practical survival plan, daily checklist, practice strategy, and RevisionDojo tools to boost marks fast.
body_markdown:
### The week you stop negotiating with chemistry


At some point in every IB student’s year, there’s a quiet moment where you do the math. Seven days. One syllabus. A brain that keeps replaying TikTok sounds instead of electron configurations. And there it is, in plain numbers: you need **IB Chemistry** to work *now* .


This is not the romantic version of studying, the one with color-coded notes and a sunrise run. This is the survival week. The goal isn’t “learn everything.” The goal is: **turn your next seven days into the highest mark-per-hour you’ve ever lived** in **IB Chemistry** .


You can do that. But only if you accept one rule: you’re not revising to feel prepared. You’re revising to perform.


A student tries to learn IB Chemistry in 7 days while chaos increases


### Your 1-week IB Chemistry checklist (read this first)


Use this as your north star whenever you feel lost.


-


**Pick your exam level (SL/HL)** and identify your weakest 3 topics.


-


Spend **30% of time learning** , **70% practicing** (questions + corrections).


-


Build a formula-and-method “one-pager” you rewrite daily from memory.


-


Do at least **2 timed mixed sets** and **1 full mock** in the week.
